rationale: MVP package C02 of the agent fleet controller wedge selected in docs/inquiry/agentic-stack-2026-10-09/REPORT.md; dependent on earlier packages where stated.

work.title: C02 — Quota manager: limits, circuit breakers, rerouting in shadow mode
work.description: Parse usage-limit/reset signals from the official CLIs' local output and usage data; keep per-provider availability state with circuit breakers (stop probing until reset); classify each queued task as eligible for another provider or local model, or queue it; treat a hard budget cap denial as a stop, never a fallback. Default is shadow mode: log what the manager would have done; `--enforce` is explicit.
work.acceptance_criteria: Every observed limit event in two weeks is recorded with provider, reset time and the task affected; shadow log shows the decision the manager would have taken; enforce mode verified on a disposable task set; no task is retried against an exhausted provider. Stop rule: fewer than 3 limit events per week across both workloads → hold C02/C03 and keep C01 as a utility.
